messages.watcher.help_admin:
🤖 Playtime Bot - Admin Commands

STATUS:
  • status - Show playtime status for all children
  • request [name] <duration> - Test request flow

MANAGEMENT:
  • [name] <duration> - Add time to bank
  • [name] +<duration> - Add time to bank explicitly
  • [name] -<duration> - Remove time from bank
  • [name] =<duration> - Set bank to exact value
  • break [name] <duration> - Set accrued playtime to exact value
  • end [name] - End active session
  • rollover [name] - Force weekly rollover
  • block [name] - Enable grant block mode (ends active session)
  • unblock [name] - Disable grant block mode

ACTIVITY CLAIMS:
  • claims [name] - List pending activity claims
  • ack [name] - Grant all pending activity claims to bank

PROFILES:
  • profile list - List available rule profiles
  • profile show <name> - Show profile settings
  • profile define <name> KEY=VALUE ... - Create or replace profile using env-style settings
  • profile use <name> <child> - Assign a profile to a child
    required keys: WEEKLY_ADDITION_TIME, MAX_BANK_TIME, ACCRUED_PLAYTIME_MAX_TIME, BREAK_RECOVERY_RATE, BLACKOUT_PERIOD_MON..BLACKOUT_PERIOD_SUN

Duration must include unit: h, m, or min (examples: 1h, 30m, 30min, 1.5h, 3x1h15m)
Note: [name] is optional; omitting it applies the command to all children. Child names are case-insensitive.
messages.watcher.help_child:
🤖 Playtime Bot

COMMANDS:
  • <duration> - Request playtime (must include h, m, or min)
  • <duration> <activity> - Submit an activity claim for extra playtime
  • status - See playtime status for everyone
  • end - End your active session early

EXAMPLES:
  • 30m - Request 30 minutes
  • 1.5h - Request 1 hour 30 minutes
  • 30m cleaned my room - Claim 30 minutes for cleaning your room
